doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Day two opens: June 14, 1996
summary: Stitt opens the second day of the interview and asks again about Peggy Lee and the song Fever.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Day two of the Shirley Horn interview. The date is June 14th, 1996, and the interview is being done at the residence of Shirley Horn, 2018 Lawrence Street,

Northeast, for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Project, and the Unsung and Sung Jazz Project. Close enough for something. Yesterday we talked about your vocal influences, and among them you mentioned Peggy Lee. I wanted to just revisit that, and if you could talk specifically about what about Peggy Lee‘s style that you like, and also I was listening to The Main Ingredient, and you do Fever on there, and I was wondering if that was some sort of . . .
